notes.text: We've resolved an issue where the Editing Status column in a grid table overlapped with adjacent columns on larger screens
We've resolved an issue where SmartLink navigation landed on the wrong page when composite-entity key fields contained empty string values
List report pages and analytical list pages now apply default filter values defined using settings from Fiori launchpad when the app is loading
We've resolved an issue where custom filter values weren't restored when returning to a list report page after navigating away
The required field validation is no longer triggered incorrectly in an inline creation row when a user opens a value help or a date picker is opened from a field in that row

We've resolved an issue where clicking the Create button in a grid table in inline creation mode moved the focus to an existing row that included an error instead of moving it to the newly created empty row
We now ensure that the currency value and currency code fields in the visual filter bar are read correctly by the screen reader
We now ensure that the Editing Status column in grid and tree tables is read correctly by the screen reader
